# Datamining: Cold Shoulder Challenge “Cryptid Hunt” (2 weeks)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_147_nukaknights-post-datamining-challenge-cold-shoulder.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Once again there will be a new challenge event with daily and weekly tasks. This time you need the double-barreled shotgun with cold damage: **Cold Shoulder** from **Season 12** (current season) (See also: Tip: The 'Cold Shoulder' double-barreled shotgun (Game Board / Season 12)).

## When does the Cold Shoulder Cryptid Hunt Challenge take place?

Period: **16.05.-30.05.2023**

## Daily Challenges

**Week 1:**

- Cryptid Hunt: Kill a Grafton monster with the Cold Shoulder. (3 lunch boxes)
- Cryptid Hunt: Kill a Deathclaw with the Cold Shoulder. (3 Legendary Modules)
- Cryptid Hunt: Kill a Snallygaster with the Cold Shoulder. (250 score points)
- Cryptid Hunt: Kill 5 Super Mutants with the Cold Shoulder. (3 skill packs)
- Cryptid Hunt: Kill a glowing cryptid with the Cold Shoulder. (250 score points)
- Cryptid Hunt: Kill 5 Mirelurks with the Cold Shoulder. (250 score points)
- Cryptid Hunt: Kill a Mega Sloth with the Cold Shoulder. (3 Easy Repair Kits)

**Week 2:**

- Cryptid Hunt: Kill a Mega Sloth with the Cold Shoulder. (3 lunch boxes)
- Cryptid Hunt: Kill a glowing cryptid with the Cold Shoulder. (3 Legendary Modules)
- Cryptid Hunt: Kill 3 Cryptids with the Cold Shoulder (3 Lunchboxes)
- Cryptid Hunt: Kill a Wendigo with the Cold Shoulder. (3 skill packs)
- Cryptid Hunt: Kill a Deathclaw with the Cold Shoulder. (250 score points)
- Cryptid Hunt: Kill 5 Troggs with the Cold Shoulder. (3 Easy Repair Kits)
- Cryptid Hunt: Kill a Scorchbeast with the Cold Shoulder. (250 score points)

## Weekly Challenges

- **Week 1:** Complete 5 of 7 Daily Cryptid Hunting Challenges from Week 1. (Cold Blood Paint)
- **Week 2:** Cryptid Hunt: Complete 5 of 7 Daily Cryptid Hunt Challenges from Week 2. (tannery bench)

## Event Challenges

- Kill 25 cryptids with the Cold Shoulder during the Cryptid Hunt event (Waidmann's Bed)

![Cryptid Hunt Challenges Datamining](/uploads/cold-shoulder-challenges-2884.png)
